name: August Bank Holiday Competition 2017

venue.name: Collingwood Suite, Gosling Sports Park
venue.address: Stanborough Rd, Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire AL8 6DQ

information: Registration opens on Friday 30th June at 7pm BST. The steps for registration are as follows: - Register for the competition on the left. - Once confirmed on the waiting list, pay the fee on the [UKCA website](http://www.ukca.org/competitions/upcoming-competitions/abhc-2017/registration). - Once we have confirmed correct payment, we will accept your registration. This fee is non-refundable, as it represents a commitment to attending the competition. There is a competitor limit of 100. Registration is now closed.
